# Minizip runtime

Bundled as `Assets/Plugins/AssimpLinux/libminizip.so` for Linux x86_64 Assimp model import. Source package: Ubuntu 26.04 `libminizip1t64`, version `1:1.3.dfsg+really1.3.1-1ubuntu3.2`. SHA-256: `38feb76bd7381dbf7ade355b2cfe04a3d3f84afe13626124b7d4b608e3729142`.
